proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4963 chagala includes Bashkarik chēl, Bhojpuri chērī, Hindi cherī and Gujarati chāḷī goat in section 1. These contracted goat forms fit that section; retained-g Bengali chagol needs a learned-form check against the strengthened branch. Exact survey form tʃʰeɾi is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
